newsitem.title: USA: NY/NJ Port Authority sets regular monthly meeting.
newsitem.headline: NY/NJ Port Authority sets regular monthly meeting.

text.p: The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey on Tuesday said that it will hold its regular monthly meeting on Novemer 7 at 1430 EST.
The board is expected to take up the Authority's capital budget.

A preliminary draft of the budget showed the bi-state agency expected to raise spending 19 percent to $3.1 billion but avoid increasing fares and tolls partly by cutting 500 employees, according to the Newark Star Ledger.
The final budget is expected to be voted on at the board's December 12 meeting.
